name: Slovene for AnySoftKeyboard
blurb: Slovene layouts and dictionary for AnySoftKeyboard keyboard app.
description:
Slovene layouts and dictionary for AnySoftKeyboard keyboard app.

This is an expansion layouts pack for AnySoftKeyboard.
Install AnySoftKeyboard first, and then select the desired layout from AnySoftKeyboard Settings->Keyboards menu.
